# Notice

The persistent notice.

`LL.Notice` · Components · Containers

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Notice tone="danger" title="Offline progress paused" action={<LL.Button size="sm">Retry</LL.Button>}>The server did not answer.</LL.Notice>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Notice"></x-import>
```

## Props (NoticeProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'info' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | info by default; danger is an alert. |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` | What happened, in words. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | The detail. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` | Usually one Button. |
| `busy` | `boolean` | A pulse while something is under way. |
| `busyLabel` | `string` | "In progress" by default. |
| `className` | `string` |  |
